questions.q: What is the capital of Zambia?

questions.q: Which metal is Zambia's main export?

questions.q: What is Zambia's currency?

questions.q: Which waterfall does Zambia share with Zimbabwe?
questions.why: Its local name means 'the smoke that thunders'.

questions.q: Who has been President of Zambia since 2021?
questions.why: He is a businessman.

questions.q: Which railway links Zambia to Tanzania's coast?
questions.why: China helped build it in the 1970s.

questions.q: Which explorer named Victoria Falls in 1855?
questions.why: A town is named after him.

questions.q: Which man-made lake did Zambia and Zimbabwe create in 1959?
questions.why: It is one of the world's largest reservoirs.

questions.q: In which year did Zambia win the Africa Cup of Nations?

questions.q: Who led Zambia back to multi-party democracy in 1991?
questions.why: He was a trade union leader.

questions.q: What was Kaunda's political philosophy called?
questions.why: It mixed African and Christian ideas.

questions.q: Which river forms Zambia's border with Zimbabwe?
questions.why: Victoria Falls is on it.

questions.q: Which park is famous for walking safaris?
questions.why: Walking safaris began there.

questions.q: Which maize porridge is Zambia's staple food?

questions.q: Which pool at the edge of Victoria Falls lets people swim at the drop?

questions.q: Which city is near Victoria Falls in Zambia?

questions.q: What is Zambia's national football team called?

questions.q: Which bat migration in Kasanka is the biggest mammal migration?

questions.q: Which national park is one of Africa's largest?

questions.q: Which Ngoni ceremony in eastern Zambia is held each February?

questions.q: Which park along the Zambezi faces Zimbabwe's Mana Pools?

questions.q: Which plain in the west hosts Africa's second-largest wildebeest migration?
